scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of strict global uniqueness, block budget split, and sharp support rule; exact rational and numerical verification is supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple cactus graphs, positive per-conductance prices, linear fixed budget, nonnegative weights. Interior arbitrary-price cycle weights defined implicitly. Specialist prior art may be unlocated; no independent validation.
title: Exact price-driven support transitions for D-optimal conductances on cactus networks
